source.mutability: Adobe exposes the current complete document at a mutable official endpoint. The hash and byte count make generation fail closed until a vendor revision is consciously reviewed.

historical_authority.reconciliation: Adobe's immutable official SDK repository is older and split across ten Swagger 1.2 resource files. Every one of its 92 routes exists in the current 184-operation live OpenAPI, so the live document is used as the superset authority while the commit guards continuity.

auth.selected: OAuth bearer supplied only by the enrolled Adobe Sign connection
auth.note: Authorization and optional actor-impersonation headers are never operation arguments. The connection selects the authenticated Acrobat Sign actor.

tenant_routing.note: The runtime resolves each call against the selected connection base_url. Full /api/rest/v6 paths work with either an apiAccessPoint origin or a versioned tenant API root, and the connection origin remains the pagination and redirect pin.

root_pin_exception.proof: The official userId parameter description says the token owner is selected by replacing userId with the literal me. The generic structural OpenAPI prover has no literal path-parameter expansion, so only the compatibility root omits openapi_source; all leaves retain the hash pin.

source_decision.reason: No live Adobe Acrobat Sign connection was available for empirical field-presence and version-signal proof. OpenAPI response shapes alone are not used to claim a synchronized Source.

exclusions.reason: The official delete requires a JSON body. The current REST transport intentionally does not serialize DELETE bodies, so publishing this route would certify a call shape the runtime cannot execute.
